ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_002.source_old: I am glad that you asked, my apprentices. Since Doomhammer has no doubt planted spies in our ranks, I decided to keep our true objective to myself.
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_002.source_new: I am glad that you asked, my apprentices. Since Doomhammer has no doubt planted spies in our ranks, I decided to keep our true objective to myself.

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_003.source_old: But now, at long last, I can reveal the truth!
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_003.source_new: But now, at long last, I can reveal the truth!

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_004.source_old: After I awoke from my slumber, I spent months searching through Medivh's librarly, for anything about the Tomb of Sargeras.
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_004.source_new: After I awoke from my slumber, I spent months searching through Medivh's library, for anything about the Tomb of Sargeras.

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_005.source_old: |cffffcc00Cho:|r What is this tomb? |n|n|cffffcc00Gall:|r And where is it located?
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_005.source_new: |cffffcc00Cho:|r What is this tomb? |n|n|cffffcc00Gall:|r And where is it located?

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_006.source_old: The tomb contains the remains of an avatar of the Dark Titan Sargeras. The once-master of Kil'jaeden himself.
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_006.source_new: The tomb contains the remains of an avatar of the Dark Titan Sargeras. The once-master of Kil'jaeden himself.

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_007.source_old: Long ago the tomb was sealed and the entire landmass was sunk beneath the ocean waves.
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_007.source_new: Long ago the tomb was sealed and the entire landmass was sunk beneath the ocean waves.

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_008.source_old: |cffffcc00Cho:|r You... intend to raise the entire tomb from the sea? |n|n|cffffcc00Gall:|r And this is the reason we needed the powers of the elven rune stones?
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_008.source_new: |cffffcc00Cho:|r You... intend to raise the entire tomb from the sea? |n|n|cffffcc00Gall:|r And this is the reason we needed the powers of the elven rune stones?

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_009.source_old: Yes. And once I enter the tomb, I won't need the Horde anymore. And even the demons will bow to my will!
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_009.source_new: Yes. And once I enter the tomb, I won't need the Horde anymore. And even the demons will bow to my will!

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_010.source_old: Now, behold the power of true Darkness!
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_010.source_new: Now, behold the power of true Darkness!

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_011.source_old: A few more days in the mountains and we'll reach the lake. According to reports, our armada is filling through the River Brightwater, in Tirisfal. They will provide naval support for us when we get to Fenris isle.
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_011.source_new: A few more days in the mountains and we'll reach the lake. According to reports, our armada is filling through the River Brightwater, in Tirisfal. They will provide naval support for us when we get to Fenris isle.

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_012.source_old: Why don't we just kill these humans, Warchief?
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_012.source_new: Why don't we just kill these humans, Warchief?

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_013.source_old: I have had a meeting with their chieftain, and they have agreed to let us through their territory without a fight if we spare them.
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_013.source_new: I had a meeting with their chieftain, and they had agreed to let us through their territory without a fight, if we spared them.

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_014.source_old: Betraying their own kind!? Pfah! These humans have no honor.
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_014.source_new: Betraying their own kind!? Pfah! These humans have no honor.

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_015.source_old: Tirisfal and the outskirts of the wizard-city of Dalaran are heavily fortified. Crossing the Lordamere Lake through Alterac was our best option. And with this new arrangement we will arrive at full strength.
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_015.source_new: Tirisfal and the outskirts of the wizard-city of Dalaran are heavily fortified. Crossing the Lordamere Lake through Alterac was our best option. And with this new arrangement we will arrive at full strength.

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_016.source_old: Where is the Warchief? I must speak with him at once!
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_016.source_new: Where is the Warchief? I must speak with him at once!

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_017.source_old: Scratcher!? What are you doing here? You should be in Quel'Thalas, overseeing the siege of Silvermoon.
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_017.source_new: Scratcher!? What are you doing here? You should be in Quel'Thalas, overseeing the siege of Silvermoon.

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_018.source_old: ...Gul'dan... his entire clan, as well as the Twilight's Hammer have betrayed us! Silvermoon still stands and the Amani have been pushed back into Zul'Aman. He went west with his entire force!
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_018.source_new: ...Gul'dan... his entire clan, as well as the Twilight's Hammer have betrayed us! Silvermoon still stands and the Amani have been pushed back into Zul'Aman. He went west with his entire force!

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_019.source_old: The wretched Warlock? He seeks to mock me? To undermine me? The Horde and everything we've accomplished here? I was wrong in sparing him, and now I will right that mistake.
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_019.source_new: The wretched Warlock? He seeks to mock me? To undermine me? The Horde and everything we've accomplished here? I was wrong in sparing him, and now I will right that mistake.

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_021.source_old: We are yours to command, Warchief!
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_021.source_new: We are yours to command, Warchief!

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_022.source_old: Gul'dan and his fleet fled west. You will take three battalions of Blackrock, and Blacktooth Grin warriors, as well as Zuluhed's Dragonmaw. Pursue that vile traitor to the end of the earth if you have to!
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_022.source_new: Gul'dan and his fleet fled west. You will take three battalions of Blackrock, and Blacktooth Grin warriors, and Zuluhed's Dragonmaw. Pursue that vile traitor to the end of the earth if you have to!

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_023.source_old: I will gather the troops, Warchief.
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_023.source_new: I will gather the troops, Warchief.

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_024.source_old: Destroy the renegade clans and return with the head of Gul'dan.
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_024.source_new: Destroy the renegade clans and return with the head of Gul'dan.

ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_026.source_old: I will use the skull of that filthy traitor as a reminder to never have dealings with dark sorcerers again! And to show everyone what happens when you cross the Warchief of the Horde!
ToD_A04_CNMC4_VO_026.source_new: I will use the skull of that filthy traitor as a reminder to never have dealings with black sorcerers again! And to show everyone what happens when you cross the Warchief of the Horde!
